title: State Street 推出符合 GENIUS Act 的貨幣市場基金，用於 stablecoin 儲備
content: The launch comes amid growing competition among financial institutions to manage assets backing dollar-pegged stablecoins.
summary_zh: State Street 推出符合 GENIUS Act 的貨幣市場基金，管理 dollar-pegged stablecoin 資產。

title: Ripple targets Africa’s booming remittance market with Flutterwave investment
content: Ripple’s investment in Flutterwave will bring RLUSD, Ripple Payments and XRPL to one of Africa’s largest fintechs as blockchain remittances gain traction.

title: Why US-regulated Bitcoin perpetuals could change crypto trading
content: US-regulated Bitcoin perpetual futures could give retail and institutional traders new ways to access crypto derivatives.
summary_zh: 美國監管 Bitcoin perpetual futures 將為零售與機構交易者提供新衍生品管道。

title: Binance says it considers EU license compliant amid reports of potential rejection
content: Without specifically calling out a report on Binance’s EU license, the crypto exchange warned that any rejection forcing it to delay activities in the region could “weaken liquidity” and present other potential risks.

title: Bitcoin stocks divergence returns as BTC dips to $66K while oil drops under $78
content: Bitcoin joined oil in heading lower while stocks gained on US-Iran peace momentum, with traders seeing a quick end to the BTC price rebound.
summary_zh: BTC 跌至 66,000 美元、油價跌破 78 美元，Bitcoin 與油價同步走低。

title: SpaceX’s debut: A win for crypto price discovery, a fail for tokenized access
content: SpaceX’s blockbuster debut didn’t just mint a trillionaire; it became a real-world stress test for crypto’s promise of democratized market access.

title: Why a ‘safe’ AI can turn dangerous in the wrong company
content: A 15-day AI agent simulation shows why short tests may miss long-term risks shaped by tools, rules and other agents.

title: Bitcoin sell-off toward $60K may resume as Japan hikes interest rates
content: Japan’s highest rates since 1995 are putting global liquidity back in focus as traders anticipate 26%–38% BTC price declines.
summary_zh: 日本利率升至 1995 年以來最高，交易員預期 BTC 可能下跌 26%–38%。

title: Robinhood cuts 10% of workforce as Tenev touts business strength
content: Robinhood cuts about 10% of staff as CEO Vlad Tenev says business “has never been stronger” despite weak Q1 trading.

title: Solana treasury firms resist Forward Industries’ consolidation push
content: Two Solana treasury firms rejected acquisition proposals from Forward Industries, while a third offer expired without a response.
summary_zh: 兩家 Solana treasury 公司拒絕 Forward Industries 收購提案，第三案已過期。

title: Bitcoin doesn't need Ethereum-style yield, says Strategy's Michael Saylor
content: Michael Saylor says Bitcoin does not need staking or inflation, outlining a five-layer “Digital Asset Stack” that generates returns through credit and equity products built around BTC.
summary_zh: Michael Saylor 提出 Bitcoin 五層 Digital Asset Stack，強調無需 staking 或通脹。

title: Bitcoin miner IREN enters Europe with Nostrum acquisition as AI pivot accelerates
content: The acquisition adds about 490 megawatts of secured power in Spain as IREN expands beyond Bitcoin mining and builds its European AI cloud platform.
summary_zh: IREN 收購 Nostrum 取得西班牙 490 兆瓦電力，加速歐洲 AI 雲平台布局。

title: Bitcoin recovery rests on US-Iran deal as momentum remains weak
content: LVRG Research director Nick Ruck says Bitcoin could face a “volatile path” if a recently agreed peace deal between the US and Iran breaks down.
summary_zh: LVRG Research 指出若美伊和平協議破局，Bitcoin 將面臨高波動路徑。

title: US government watchdog urges FDIC to coordinate on crypto oversight
content: The US Government Accountability Office says that regulators, including the FDIC, lack an “ongoing coordination mechanism for addressing blockchain risks.”

title: Anthropic shutdown makes a strong case for decentralized AI: Grayscale
content: Grayscale says decentralized AI tokens gained after the US government ordered Anthropic to cut access to its latest AI models, showing user demand for alternatives to centralized AI.
summary_zh: Grayscale 表示美國政府要求 Anthropic 切斷模型存取後，去中心化 AI 代幣上漲。

title: Crypto Exchange Binance Will Be Rejected for EU Regulatory License: Reuters
content: Binance said it believes it is compliant as a regulatory deadline in the European Union nears—and a report says it's likely to lose access.

title: ChatGPT Is Still Huge, But Rival AI Chatbots Are Catching Up Fast
content: Sensor Tower's State of AI 2026 report shows ChatGPT's audience share slipping below 50% for the first time, as Gemini's default-app advantage and Claude's Pentagon-fueled rally eat into OpenAI's lead.
summary_zh: Sensor Tower 報告顯示 ChatGPT 受眾市占首次跌破 50%，Gemini 與 Claude 快速追趕。

title: FBI Says It Foiled Drone Attack Plot Targeting White House UFC Event
content: Federal prosecutors allege five men planned to use explosive-laden drones and sniper teams to take out "high-value targets" at the UFC event.

title: Coinbase Gears Up to Launch Tokenized Stock Trading, Crypto and Equities Options
content: Publicly traded crypto exchange Coinbase added to its feature set Tuesday as it seeks to become the "everything exchange."
summary_zh: Coinbase 將推出 tokenized stock 交易及加密與股票期權，目標成為全方位交易所。

title: Japan Rates Hit Three-Decade High, But No ‘Meaningful Disruption’ to Crypto Market
content: Japan's central bank lifted rates to a level unseen in decades, a move that once shook crypto markets—yet prices barely stirred.

title: SpaceX Shares Hit New High as Elon Musk's Firm Agrees to Acquire AI Startup Cursor for $60 Billion
content: The all-stock deal would make Cursor a wholly owned SpaceX subsidiary and deepen the company's push into AI following its blockbuster IPO.

title: 7 Ways Businesses Are Using Crypto Swap APIs
content: Real-world case studies show how the best crypto swap APIs help wallets, aggregators, and protocols improve onboarding and retention.

title: Robinhood Trims Headcount by 10% Amid Crypto Revenue Crunch
content: Robinhood is letting go of 10% of its employees, attempting to streamline operations amid a downturn in crypto-related revenue.

title: Scale of Stablecoin Adoption in Nigeria Makes Risks 'More Pronounced', Says IMF
content: Efforts to suppress stablecoin use are “likely to be only partly effective,” the International Monetary Fund’s researchers said.
summary_zh: IMF 指出奈及利亞 stablecoin 採用規模擴大，相關風險更為顯著。

title: Hyperliquid ETFs Draw In $172M Since Launch as HYPE Hits All-Time High
content: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have shed nearly $5.6 billion since Hyperliquid ETFs launched, highlighting market divergence.
summary_zh: Hyperliquid ETFs 推出以來吸金 1.72 億美元，同期比特幣 ETF 流出近 56 億美元。

title: Morning Minute: HYPE Soars to ATH as SPCX Takes Off
content: SPCX jumped 20%+ in after hours trading last night with all eyes on its Hyperliquid perp, leading to a 12% spike in HYPE.

title: BlackRock Debuts BITA Bitcoin ETF, Trading Partial Upside for Double-Digit Yield
content: BlackRock launched an ETF that limits Bitcoin gains in exchange for double-digit payouts by selling call options on its holdings.
summary_zh: BlackRock 推出 BITA Bitcoin ETF，透過賣出 call option 換取雙位數收益率。

title: South Korea Charges 23 Over Crypto Laundering Tied to $11M Cambodian Scam Ring
content: South Korea has arrested dozens accused of moving $11.1 million in crypto for a Cambodia-based phishing group.

title: Jim Cramer says SpaceX investors aren't buying earnings — they're buying Elon Musk
content: CNBC's Jim Cramer said SpaceX investors are betting on Elon Musk's vision and track record, rather than the company's current earnings power.

title: Anthropic's Fable shutdown is a big moment for open-source AI
content: Anthropic’s Fable shutdown could boost open-source AI, but many of the models gaining traction are Chinese.

title: Databricks sales growth tops 80%, but margin are shrinking from swarm of AI agents
content: Databricks is seeing higher growth as AI agents assist with data analysis, but all that activity is significantly increasing costs.

title: Intel begins production of most-advanced chip, inching closer to possible Apple deal
content: Intel is entering production of 18A-P, its most-advanced chip node that could be the target of a coming deal with Apple

title: SpaceX's blistering start still faces key tests that will determine the stock's true value
content: SpaceX's stock has yet to face true price discovery.

title: DOJ assists Musk's xAI in NAACP air pollution suit, asks court to toss case
content: The DOJ is asking a Mississippi federal court to dismiss a lawsuit filed by the NAACP against Elon Musk's xAI, now owned by SpaceX.

title: Snap unveils $2,195 AR glasses as CEO Evan Spiegel bets on post-smartphone future
content: Snap is launching its first AR glasses geared toward the broader public instead of developers.
